#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Print order count, paid count, paid revenue and top paid customer for a JSON array of orders.

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "usage: summarize.sh FILE" >&2
  exit 2
fi

file=$1

if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
  echo "error: file not found: $file" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! jq -e 'type == "array"' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "error: not a valid JSON array of orders: $file" >&2
  exit 1
fi

orders=$(jq 'length' "$file")
paid=$(jq '[.[] | select(.status == "paid")] | length' "$file")
revenue=$(jq '[.[] | select(.status == "paid") | .total] | add // 0' "$file")
top=$(jq -r '
  [.[] | select(.status == "paid")]
  | group_by(.customer)
  | map({customer: .[0].customer, revenue: (map(.total) | add)})
  | sort_by([-.revenue, .customer])
  | if length == 0 then "-" else .[0].customer end
' "$file")

printf 'orders: %s\n' "$orders"
printf 'paid: %s\n' "$paid"
LC_NUMERIC=C printf 'revenue: %.2f\n' "$revenue"
printf 'top: %s\n' "$top"

    f.write_text(json.dumps(orders))
    return f

    f = write_orders(
        tmp_path,
        [
            {"id": 1, "customer": "bob", "total": 10.5, "status": "paid"},
            {"id": 2, "customer": "alice", "total": 4.25, "status": "paid"},
            {"id": 3, "customer": "bob", "total": 2, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": 4, "customer": "carol", "total": 3.1, "status": "paid"},
        ],
    )
    out = run(str(f))
    assert out.returncode == 0
    assert out.stdout == "orders: 4\npaid: 3\nrevenue: 17.85\ntop: bob\n"
    assert out.stderr == ""

    f = write_orders(
        tmp_path,
        [{"id": 1, "customer": "bob", "total": 9, "status": "pending"}],

    assert out.stdout == "orders: 1\npaid: 0\nrevenue: 0.00\ntop: -\n"

    f = write_orders(tmp_path, [])
